magic_mode.description: Magic recovery mode: 'full' for -M (entire FS), 'deleted' for -m (only deleted files)

info_mode.description: Informational mode: 'superblock', 'superblock_extended', 'journal', 'histogram', 'histogram_extended', 'version', 'transaction_list', 'transaction_list_extended', 'transaction_list_extended' (uses -x flag for extended info in histogram/transaction_list modes). Note: -x is handled via mode suffixes here, but 'version' and 'journal' do not use -x in standard docs, only S, H, T do. The schema enum is simplified in template logic but this reflects valid modes.

selection_mode.description: Selection mode: 'block', 'inode', 'filename', 'input_list'; only one may be set

filename.description: Filename (from FS root) for -f; must be relative, no leading slash

input_list_file.description: Path to file with double-quoted filenames for -i

time_after.description: Unix timestamp for -a (after); defaults to now -24h if omitted

time_before.description: Unix timestamp for -b (before); defaults to now if omitted

quality_high.description: Enable -Q for high-quality recover with directory journal data

try_journal_superblock.description: Attempt to find journal using superblock data (-c)

recover_damaged.description: Attempt to recover all files from damaged FS (-D)

journal_file.description: Path to external journal file for -j

target_dir.description: Output directory for recovered files (-d); created if missing

filesystem_path.description: Path to block device or filesystem image (required positional arg)
